get.description: Always 200 {'status': 'ok'} while the process serves: no auth and no database query (API-010). Intentionally public. It answers 200 even when the database is down (ADR-0010).

The package version and the commit this deploy was built from. Intentionally public and unversioned: the post-deploy smoke test (.github/workflows/deployed.yml) waits for `commit` to be the deploy it was triggered by. The web app reads it to show the API's version.

Operator route: one scheduler pass (session status advance, queue auto-fill, due song builds started, one Drive job batch), answered after it finishes. Requires x-tick-secret equal to TICK_SECRET, or to TICK_SECRET_PREVIOUS while a rotation overlaps; refuses every call when TICK_SECRET is unset.

post.summary: Create or refresh the caller's user record
post.description: Upserts the caller's users row and provisions their principal (deejaytools-dancer) in one transaction. The email stored is the session token's email claim; the body's email is used only when the token carries none. On conflict only email and updated_at change; names are user-managed after creation. Authenticated-only: a verified credential, no scope.

409.description: The email belongs to another sign-in's users row.

get.description: Returns the caller's users row, with role derived from their principal's grants, and the staff roles they hold per event (event_roles). A valid token with no users row answers 401 USER_NOT_SYNCED. Authenticated-only: a verified credential, no scope.

401.description: Missing or invalid token, or not yet synced.

post.summary: Submit a song to an event
post.description: Enters one of the caller's songs, or a live song shared with the caller as its linked partner, in an event, then queues its Drive copy (a failure to queue is reported, never answered). An entity may have one song per division per event; at The Open, Classic may split into prelims_only and finals_only; both partners of a shared song fill the same slot. The caller who submits it is the one who sees and withdraws the submission. Requires deejaytools.submissions.write.

409.description: Already submitted, or the entity's slot is taken.

delete.description: Deletes one of the caller's submissions; after the delete, queues its Drive copy, if it has one, for trashing. Requires deejaytools.submissions.write.

post.summary: Upload one chunk of a song
post.description: Chunked upload, multipart/form-data. Each chunk is staged; the final one is assembled, checked by its magic bytes and becomes a song, returned at once. Tagging, the Drive upload and the Drive fields follow in the background; the song is removed again if that fails and nothing references it yet. Requires deejaytools.songs.write; on_behalf_of_user_id also needs deejaytools.delegation.act: through a role (an admin's), or on the event event_id names (that event's DJ or event manager). submit_to_event=true (with on_behalf_of_user_id and event_id) also submits the song to that event in the same request, the dancer as submitter, refused with 409 ENTITY_SLOT_TAKEN before anything is saved when the slot is taken.

400.description: A field or the file is refused.

403.description: Acting for another user, not allowed.

409.description: Chunks missing (CHUNK_MISSING), or with submit_to_event the entity's slot is taken (ENTITY_SLOT_TAKEN).

Returns a failed job to the queue: pending, zero attempts, due now. Any other status is a 409. Requires deejaytools.drivejobs.write.

Requires deejaytools.checkins.write. Checks an entity into the session's priority or standard queue (admission rules, ADR-0006) and auto-fills the active queue. The song must belong to the user, or be a live song shared with them as its linked partner, and, for an event session, be submitted to the event. For a shared song the entity is the owner's pair with that partner, whichever partner checks in, so the two cannot both hold an entry; its entityPairId must name that pair or one the caller leads. A couple holds one entry per session: a pair is refused while the other partner's pair for the same couple has one (each pair's partner row stands for the other's account, by link or, unlinked, by email). With on_behalf_of_user_id the caller also needs deejaytools.delegation.act on the session's event, and the entity comes from the song.

get.description: Requires deejaytools.checkins.read. The caller's check-ins that still have a queue entry (solo, pairs they lead, managed partnerships they own), and those of pairs led by someone else whose partner row in the leader's address book is linked to the caller, newest first, with queue position, overall position, run count and canWithdraw (false for the linked partner's view: only the leader withdraws).

delete.description: Requires deejaytools.checkins.write, and the entity must be the caller's (solo, a pair they lead, or a managed partnership they own). Removes the queue entry, closes the gap, records 'withdrawn' (reason self_withdrew) and auto-fills, as an admin withdraw does.

post.description: Requires deejaytools.queue.manage on the entry's event. Moves a priority or standard entry to the bottom of the active queue. While the session is live the caps apply: priority needs room under the priority cap; standard needs an empty priority queue and room under the standard cap. A completed or cancelled session skips the caps.

post.description: Requires deejaytools.queue.manage on the entry's event. Any active entry, not only position 1: records a run, removes the entry, closes the gap and auto-fills.

post.description: Requires deejaytools.queue.manage on the entry's event. Rotates an active entry to the bottom of the active queue (no run recorded) and auto-fills. An entry already at the bottom is left where it is.

post.description: Requires deejaytools.queue.manage on the entry's event. Removes an entry from any queue without recording a run, closes the gap and auto-fills.
